subject: Request: Pilot extension & sandbox credit due to integration queue
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@finsera.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Finsera Engineering <eng@finsera.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot pause — asking for onboarding buffer and credits

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from my side — our integration sprint ran into a blocking issue with the SAML adapter and our data pipeline. The engineering team is on it but we need an extra two weeks to get the connector producing stable payloads.

We were hoping Redwood could: 1) extend the pilot window by 14 days, and 2) top up our sandbox with ~50k token-equivalent credits so we can continue smoke tests once the fix lands.

Attached are the integration logs and a screenshot showing the SAML error. Happy to hop on a short call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
VP, Product
Finsera

Attachments:
- integration_logs_20261205.zip (log archive)
- saml_error_screenshot.png (png)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finsera.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — asking for onboarding buffer and credits

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the SAML snag.

We can absolutely support an extension and help keep momentum. I need to loop in our provisioning lead (Karthik) to confirm the credit top-up and any internal approvals, but I can provision a provisional 25k token sandbox bump immediately as a bridge while we get approvals. If your engineering team thinks they will need a full two weeks, say that explicitly and we'll do the request for the additional window.

Two quick asks from our side to make the approval fast:
- A short note on the expected resolution date (approx. ETA)
- Confirmation that the extra credits will be used for smoke/rehydration tests only (not for production traffic)

If you can share the ETA I’ll start the internal approval and queue up the provisional credit. Want to run a 15-minute sync tomorrow to align? I can do 11:00–11:30am PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@finsera.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 13:24:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — asking for onboarding buffer and credits

Thanks for the context, team. I reviewed the logs Soojin shared and we can approve a sandbox credit top-up and a 14-day pilot extension for Finsera.

Approval details:
- Provisioning: 25,000 token-equivalent credits effective immediately (provisional).
- Contingent top-up: additional 25,000 tokens pending quick manager sign-off (Lauren) if Finsera confirms two-week ETA.
- Records: I attached the internal credit approval form for compliance.

Next steps for Elena: confirm the ETA (target fix date) and reconfirm that the usage is limited to test/smoke runs. Once Lauren signs off, we’ll push the additional credits and extend the pilot end date in the portal.

Attaching: credit_approval_form.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7842

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Provisioning, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@finsera.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Finsera Engineering <eng@finsera.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — asking for onboarding buffer and credits

Thanks, Soojin and Karthik — much appreciated.

ETA: our lead engineer expects the SAML adapter patch to be in staging by 2026-12-15, with final validation completed by 2026-12-18. So a 14-day extension covers us. We confirm the credits will be used only for smoke tests and connection validation.

We’ll take the provisional 25k immediately and will follow up with a short note once staging validation passes so you can release the contingent top-up. 15-minute sync tomorrow at 11:00am PT works for me — please send a calendar invite.

Thank you both for the quick turnaround.

Elena
